individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap overlays of deconvolution scores on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot, which already displays the distribution of the data (and additionally shows scattered individual points), so it is exempt from this check by rule.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment line plots; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel D is a bar chart of a single derived statistic (log2 fold change per gene from DEG analysis), not a mean of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E consists of micrographs (H&E and IHC images), not a quantitative plot, so this check does not apply.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A shows spatial heatmap overlays with no error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - The caption explicitly defines the box (25th-75th percentile/Q1-Q3) and provides exact minima, maxima, and median values for each group/whisker.
